name: DaData Integration
description: Integrates the DaData Suggestions API for client-side autocomplete (address, full name, email, company) on form fields matched by CSS selector.
project_description: DaData Integration connects Drupal form fields to the DaData Suggestions API (https://dadata.ru/api/suggest/) to provide autocomplete dropdowns for addresses (with country/region/city/settlement/street/house granularity), companies (party), full names (fio), and emails. An admin settings form stores the API key and base URL and maps CSS selectors to suggestion types; a page attachment injects a JavaScript behavior that binds those selectors, and a server-side controller proxies each keystroke query to DaData using the site's stored token.
